description.en: Diesel Mixer Integrated Pump at /products/diesel-mixer-integrated-pump. Hopper Capacity 0.4 m³ Outlet Pressure 23 MPa

h1.en: Sound Power Level (dB) is the heading; Diesel Mixer Integrated Pump stays the subject
h1.zh: 标题是「声功率级 dB」，主体仍是柴油搅拌泵一体机输送量与输送距离询盘

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints the figures for Diesel Mixer Integrated Pump. The row to open is /products/diesel-mixer-integrated-pump. Hopper Capacity 0.4 m³. Outlet Pressure 23 MPa. Main Unit Weight 4200 kg. 40/50 model with 500 mixer. Theoretical Output 25 m³/h. Diesel Engine 4108 / 66–75 kW. 24 mm Stone (H / V) 40 / 120 m. 13 mm Stone (H / V) 60 / 180 m. The printed output cell is 25 m³/h. Series Note 30 model with 400 mixer. Dimensions (L×W×H) 4100 × 2200 × 3000 mm. The printed power cell is 4108 / 66–75 kW. Stone Capacity (H / V, ≤ 1 inch) 100 / 300 m. It shows: British Challenger 2 tank fitted with pivoting dozer blade, 2020. For transport, copy Dimensions (L×W×H) is 4100 × 2200 × 3000 mm and Main Unit Weight is 4200 kg. Theoretical Output is 25 m³/h OEM or a change starts from the listed model at /products/diesel-mixer-integrated-pump. The section title “Sound Power (W)” comes from the source page and does not add a rating. No price is printed on the product page.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台印出的是柴油搅拌泵一体机输送量与输送距离询盘的数字。要打开的行是 /products/diesel-mixer-integrated-pump。料斗容积 0.4 m³.整机重量 4200 kg.最大出口压力 23 MPa.理论输送量 25 m³/h.已印输送量是 25 m³/h。柴油机 4108 / 66–75 kW.画面主体：2020年装有可转动推土铲的坦克。已印动力是 4108 / 66–75 kW。细石输送（水平/垂直） 100 / 300 m.24 mm石子（水平/垂直） 40 / 120 m.13 mm石子（水平/垂直） 60 / 180 m.外形尺寸 4100 × 2200 × 3000 mm.40/50 model with 500 mixer。系列说明 30 model with 400 mixer.运输请抄外形尺寸是 4100 × 2200 × 3000 mm，整机重量是 4200 kg。理论输送量是 25 m³/h OEM 或改动从已列型号 /products/diesel-mixer-integrated-pump 开始。节标题「声 功率 W」来自来源页，不另加额定值。产品页没有印价格。

body.en: This section is titled “Sound Power (W)”. Diesel Mixer Integrated Pump still prints the cells below. Hopper Capacity 0.4 m³. Theoretical Output 25 m³/h. The printed output cell is 25 m³/h. Stone Capacity (H / V, ≤ 1 inch) 100 / 300 m.

body.en: Under “Sound Power Level (dB)”, Diesel Mixer Integrated Pump contributes only the printed cells in this part. Outlet Pressure 23 MPa. Diesel Engine 4108 / 66–75 kW. Series Note 30 model with 400 mixer. It shows: British Challenger 2 tank fitted with pivoting dozer blade, 2020.
body.zh: 在「声功率级 dB」下，柴油搅拌泵一体机输送量与输送距离询盘这一节只放已印出的格子。最大出口压力 23 MPa.柴油机 4108 / 66–75 kW.系列说明 30 model with 400 mixer.画面主体：2020年装有可转动推土铲的坦克。

body.en: “Sound Intensity Level (dB)” titles this part of the Diesel Mixer Integrated Pump note. The figures stay the printed ones. Main Unit Weight 4200 kg. 24 mm Stone (H / V) 40 / 120 m. Dimensions (L×W×H) 4100 × 2200 × 3000 mm. For transport, copy Dimensions (L×W×H) is 4100 × 2200 × 3000 mm and Main Unit Weight is 4200 kg.
body.zh: 「声强级 dB」是柴油搅拌泵一体机输送量与输送距离询盘这一节的标题。数字仍以已印的为准。整机重量 4200 kg.24 mm石子（水平/垂直） 40 / 120 m.外形尺寸 4100 × 2200 × 3000 mm.运输请抄外形尺寸是 4100 × 2200 × 3000 mm，整机重量是 4200 kg。

body.en: For Diesel Mixer Integrated Pump, the heading “Typical Sound Power” does not replace a cell. 40/50 model with 500 mixer. 13 mm Stone (H / V) 60 / 180 m. The printed power cell is 4108 / 66–75 kW. Theoretical Output is 25 m³/h OEM or a change starts from the listed model at /products/diesel-mixer-integrated-pump. The photograph is an image from the source page https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/sound-power-level-d_58.html.
body.zh: 对柴油搅拌泵一体机输送量与输送距离询盘而言，标题「典型 声 功率」并不替换任何格子。40/50 model with 500 mixer。13 mm石子（水平/垂直） 60 / 180 m.已印动力是 4108 / 66–75 kW。理论输送量是 25 m³/h OEM 或改动从已列型号 /products/diesel-mixer-integrated-pump 开始。配图来自来源页 https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/sound-power-level-d_58.html。

question.en: Does “Sound Power (W)” replace Hopper Capacity 0.4 m³?
question.zh: 「声 功率 W」会替换「料斗容积 0.4 m³」吗？

answer.en: No. Hopper Capacity 0.4 m³ remains the printed wording for Diesel Mixer Integrated Pump.
answer.zh: 不会。料斗容积 0.4 m³仍是柴油搅拌泵一体机输送量与输送距离询盘已印的说法。

question.en: Where does Outlet Pressure 23 MPa belong on the Diesel Mixer Integrated Pump row?
question.zh: 柴油搅拌泵一体机输送量与输送距离询盘这一行里，「整机重量 4200 kg」放在哪里？

answer.en: It belongs on /products/diesel-mixer-integrated-pump, beside the other printed cells, not under a guessed heading.
answer.zh: 它属于 /products/diesel-mixer-integrated-pump，和其他已印格子在一起，不放到猜出来的标题下面。

question.en: What does “Sound Power Level (dB)” add to Diesel Mixer Integrated Pump?
question.zh: 「声功率级 dB」给柴油搅拌泵一体机输送量与输送距离询盘增加了什么？

answer.en: It is only the section title taken from https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/sound-power-level-d_58.html. It does not add a performance figure.
answer.zh: 它只是取自 https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/sound-power-level-d_58.html 的节标题，不增加性能数字。
